import sys, struct, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
import harness, ref, invariants
from wire import seal, payload

MASK=(1<<24)-1
def custom_frame(rank, psn, payload=b'', ack=False, tos=0, ttl=64, ipid=0x1111, flags=0x4000, outgoing=False):
    hostmac=bytes((2,0,0,0,0,rank+1)); swmac=bytes((2,1,0,0,0,rank+1))
    hostip=bytes((10,0,0,rank+1)); swip=bytes((10,0,0,101+rank))
    sm,dm,si,di,q=(swmac,hostmac,swip,hostip,0x100+rank) if outgoing else (hostmac,swmac,hostip,swip,0x200+rank)
    body=struct.pack('!I',0x1f000000|((psn+1)&MASK)) if ack else payload
    bth=struct.pack('!BBHII',0x11 if ack else 4,0,65535,q,(psn&MASK)|(0 if ack else 0x80000000))
    udp=struct.pack('!HHHH',4791,4791,8+12+len(body)+4,0)
    ip=struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',0x45,tos,20+len(udp)+len(bth)+len(body)+4,ipid,flags,ttl,17,0,si,di)
    return seal(dm+sm+b'\x08\x00'+ip+udp+bth+body+b'\x00'*4)

start=5; K=3; D=2
cases=[]
# unrestricted TOS/TTL/ID and both flag values must still be accepted
ev=[]
for r in range(4):
    ev.append({'op':'wire','rank':r,'hex':custom_frame(r,(start+0)&MASK,payload(0,0,r,D),tos=0xff,ttl=1,ipid=0xbeef,flags=0x0000).hex()})
ev.append({'op':'snap','tag':'tos'})
cases.append({'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':K,'start':start,'events':ev,'trace':0})
# same but with an ACK using odd fields
ev2=[{'op':'wire','rank':2,'hex':custom_frame(2,(start+1)&MASK,ack=True,tos=7,ttl=255,ipid=0,flags=0x0000).hex()},{'op':'snap','tag':'a'}]
cases.append({'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':K,'start':start,'events':[{'op':'wire','rank':r,'hex':custom_frame(r,(start+1)&MASK,payload(0,1,r,D)).hex()} for r in range(4)]+ev2,'trace':0})
g=harness.solve(cases)['cases']
w=[ref.run(c) for c in cases]
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(g,w)):
    invariants.check(a)
    print('case',i,'match',all(a[k]==b[k] for k in b))
print('case0 state (expect 4 accepted data, 4 acks out, 1 result set):',g[0]['state'][18:26], 'tx',g[0]['state'][20:22],'packets',g[0]['packets'])
print('case1 state:',g[1]['state'][18:29],'down',g[1]['state'][10:14],'ignored',g[1]['state'][28])
"
